 November 12, 2026
 Top-ranked Ferris State football team looks to set NCAA DII consecutive win record
 with special celebrations
 BIG RAPIDS, Mich. —  
 The Ferris State University football team is looking to make history on Saturday and
 set the all-time NCAA Division II record for consecutive wins, with special celebrations
 for players and fans in attendance.
 The Bulldogs, ranked No. 1 in the nation, are hosting Roosevelt University, with kickoff
 set for 1 p.m. 
 Ferris State last week tied the all-time consecutive victory record with an 80-0 win
 over Wayne State. That matched the 40-consecutive win mark set by Grand Valley State
 University between 2005 and 2007.
 Bulldogs are also riding a 34-game home winning streak at Top Taggart Field dating
 back to 2022, which also is an all-time NCAA Division II record.
 A victory would allow the team to win the GLIAC Regular Season Championship.
 As part of Saturday's potentially historic day, all former players from the 2024 and
 2025 teams that were part of the streak are invited to the contest.
 Ferris State is planning a special postgame ceremony to celebrate the record streak
 should the Bulldogs emerge with a victory. T-shirts celebrating the streak are planned
 to be available to fans following the game while supplies last.
 The Athletic Department also be giving out record-breaking celebration hard hats prior
 to the game to the Bulldog students thru the gates while supplies last.
 The football team has won four of the last five NCAA DII National Championships, including
 the last two. The team is 10-0 overall this season and 6-0 in conference play.
 Ferris State is a consensus No. 1 team in the country again this week and holds the
 nation's top overall seed in the NPI Rankings, which will be used to help determine
 the playoff field following the conclusion of regular season play this weekend.
 Roosevelt is 5-5 overall this year and 1-5 in GLIAC play.
 Saturday also includes the annual Senior Day recognition, which takes place 20 minutes
 prior to kickoff.
 The game will be broadcast live locally by the Bulldog Sports Network and Sunny 97.3
 FM.
 The Bulldog Tailgate Show starts at 11 a.m. with the Johnson Automotive Pregame Show
 beginning at 12 p.m. The contest will also be televised on FloCollege and FloSports
 with video coverage provided by Ferris State Television.
 Tickets for Saturday's game can be purchased online at FerrisStateBulldogs.com/Tickets
 and fans are encouraged to purchase their digital tickets in advance to avoid the
 gameday lines.
 The Wheeler Pavilion Gameday Ticket Office will also open on Saturday starting at
 11:30 a.m. All tickets purchased at the box office and not online will be an additional
 $5. For more information on ticket sales, please call (231) 591-2888 or visit FerrisStateBulldogs.com.
 Football tickets for Saturday's game are $20 for adults, $15 for senior citizens ages
 65 and older and FSU faculty and staff along with $10 for students ages 5 to 17 when
 purchased in advance online plus fees.
 Ferris students with ID will be admitted free with their student identification cards
 but will be required to swipe the cards at the student only entrance found at the
 southwest gates of the stadium.
 Parking in lots near Top Taggart Field is $10 per car or $30 per oversized vehicle,
 such as a bus, motor coach, motor home, and trailer, when purchased in advance online
 plus fees.
